capital.principal_settlement: cash up to principal; excess subject to indenture; all main endpoints below initial conversion price
capital.lease_treatment: rent remains in operating cost; not separately capitalized/debited in main EV bridge

bear.assumptions: 采购延期/定价或成本压力持续，SCDE未扭亏、投资回报偏弱；更高现金消耗与稀释，较低退出倍数。

base.assumptions: FY27主要指引兑现，FY28增长约10–17%、SCDE接近/达到盈利；资本与营运资金占用回落，调整后EBITDA约15–17%收入。 与旧模型相比终值净债务250→350M，增加现金回收/持续建设缓冲；不是把已在FY27指引中的100M园区投资再次全额加总。SCAR终止已进入财报，不重复扣同一收入。

bull.assumptions: 高价值采购及LOCUST收入更快兑现、SCDE改善、自由现金流转正；虽有更多股数，但更强现金回收支持较低净债务；高倍数须由持续现金回报证明。

SBC_treatment: Company adjusted EBITDA adds SBC back; the main equity model therefore has explicit future net-share allowances (52–53m vs50.820702m current economic shares) and non-premium-to-old base multiple, rather than deducting the same future awards a second time in cash/net debt. This is a bounded dilution assumption, NOT proof all perpetual SBC cost is captured. Re-evaluate if grants or cash withholding exceed allowance. Existing restricted common already in actual common is not added again.
limits: FY2028 values/multiples/net debt/share counts/discount rate are research assumptions, not guidance, consensus or promised returns.
Current reference market capitalization uses latest disclosed Sep3 shares, not verified Oct16 actual shares; latest-quarter capital balances are Aug1, not marked to October.

Historical daily forward PE and current independently validated market NTM EPS could not be recovered after provider403/browserchallenge. Guidance-based FY27 adjusted multiples are identified as such.
FY2028 terminal debt and shares include assumed post-Aug1 cash use/recovery and dilution; future cash balances are not directly added at the current date.
No interim shareholder dividends assumed. Any retained future operating cash is reflected in target net debt; do not add FCF again.
The model is a conditional adjusted-EBITDA equity scenario, not complete owner-earnings DCF; capital/software spending, working capital, SBC and profitability constrain warranted multiples.

Known subsequent cash uses32.843m are deducted in a partial pro-forma capital bridge; other post-Aug1 operating/investing flows are NOT rolled to October. Target net debt is absolute, not an additional subtraction on top of current debt.
